cjson.determinism_note: matcher was non-deterministic pre-fix (topology _dir summed over hash-seed-ordered sets; float non-assoc flipped near-ties in cJSON's homogeneous cluster -> recall wandered 0.375-0.55 across runs). FIXED: _dir now iterates neighbor sets SORTED. cJSON now stable 0.55 across all seeds. Old 0.40 baseline was a lucky seed; deterministic baseline is 0.375.
cjson.weight_note: signal-C weight is 0.20, NOT 0.35. At 0.35 cJSON also hit 0.55 but lil REGRESSED 0.984->0.969 (signal-C overrode lil's confident interpreter-variant matches). The regression harness caught this ONLY after fixing a harness bug that silently dropped lil (crate code in src/lil.rs not src/lib.rs). 0.20 = lowest weight giving cJSON full 0.55 with lil (and all 56 name-preserving libs) intact.
cjson.note: 22/40 with signal-C + input-scalar (baseline was 16/40). Source = crustbench cJSON.c (Dave Gamble, 58 C fns, == E1 name-preserving scorable). Baseline nailed the topology-rich recursive core (parse_*/print_*) but PERMUTED the flat leaf half (12x cJSON_Create*: ()->Value/(scalar)->Value, call nothing => zero topology). signal-C (type-tag/enum-variant jaccard, W=0.35, gated) recovered 7/12 constructors -> 0.50. input-scalar signal (input element-type jaccard, W=0.12, gated) splits the int/float/double/string-array trio that signal-C grouped under one 'array' tag -> 0.55. ABLATION: baseline 0.40, +signalC 0.50, +input-scalar-ALONE 0.40 (no effect without signalC), +BOTH 0.55 -- input-scalar only refines WITHIN signalC's tag groups (composition, not independent). Residual: CreateTrue/Bool (bool-literal asymmetry) + ~8 accessor family (Get/Add/Detach shallow shape + LLM helper attractors -- the real hard core, NOT pursued). name-eq 0.15 (LLM kept 6 parse_* verbatim). BOTH signals VALIDATED: ZERO regression across 55 name-preserving libs (results/rq2_cells/regression/, two harness runs). See cjson/NOTES.md + regression/SIGNAL_C.md.
